verdict.rationale: dlt/dltHub explicitly support scheduling, backfilling, and chaining pipelines that run unattended (dlt-docs-11, dlt-docs-59, dlt-docs-70), can be deployed via a single `dlthub deploy` command or GitHub Actions/Airflow/serverless (dlt-docs-6, dlt-docs-42, dlt-docs-68), and are monitored via a Web UI/CLI (dlt-docs-15), with an AI Harness letting coding agents build and run pipelines on managed infra with logged/auditable runs (dlt-docs-13, dlt-docs-26, dlt-docs-58). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that scheduled runs execute reliably unattended over time, and more detail on failure alerting/retry semantics beyond first-party docs.
